description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: Three graduated open woven bowls are mounted vertically on one bamboo spine. Side: Each bowl projects forward from the curved support at a different height. Rear: A splayed rear foot and exposed bowl-to-spine lashings stabilize the stand. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
